title: MTDiag: A Multi-Turn Diagnostic Dataset Towards Clinically Meaningful LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is fundamentally interactive and incremental, yet the dominant paradigm for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) in medicine remains static QA benchmarks or template-based dialogues. These benchmarks say little about whether a model can serve as a diagnostic agent in a dynamic clinical encounter, with LLMs showing significant accuracy and reliability degradation in multi-turn settings. To address this issue, we present MTDiag, a large multi-turn diagnostic dialogue dataset constructed from three heterogeneous sources: DDXPlus, MIMIC-IV, and published case reports (AJCR), covering common ED presentations as well as long-tail rare and atypical conditions. All cases are normalized into a canonical schema anchored in the most comprehensive and widely-adopted medical knowledge bases (UMLS concept identifiers, with ICD-10 diagnosis codes). translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25085v1 公告类型：新 摘要：临床诊断本质上是交互式且渐进的，然而在医学中评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的主流范式仍然是静态问答基准或基于模板的对话。这些基准很少能说明模型是否能在动态临床场景中充当诊断代理，而LLMs在多轮设置中显示出显著的准确性和可靠性下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MTDiag，这是一个大型多轮诊断对话数据集，由三个异构来源构建：DDXPlus、MIMIC-IV和已发表的病例报告（AJCR），涵盖了常见的急诊科表现以及长尾罕见和非典型病症。所有病例都被标准化到一个规范模式中，该模式基于最全面且广泛采用的医学知识库（UMLS概念标识符，附带ICD-10诊断代码）。我们发布了该模式、基于UserLM-8B的语句生成流程，以及物理...
tldr: MTDiag通过构建基于多来源、标准化医学知识库的多轮诊断对话数据集，为评估LLMs在动态临床场景中的诊断能力提供了更真实且具有临床意义的基准。
en_tdlr: MTDiag provides a multi-turn diagnostic dialogue dataset built from diverse sources and standardized with medical knowledge bases, offering a more clinically meaningful benchmark for evaluating LLMs in dynamic diagnostic settings.
